signIn.title: Sign in to admin
signIn.note: Only people we have added can sign in. The link works once, for one hour.
signIn.sentBody: If this address can sign in to admin, we have sent a link to it. It works once, for one hour.
signIn.expiredBody: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
signIn.signedOutBody: Your admin session has ended on this device.

email.subject: Your link to sign in to Flowers Overseas admin
email.body: The link works once, for one hour. If you did not ask for it, you can ignore this email.

users.title: Users
users.lead: Who can sign in to admin. Removing a role or deactivating someone signs them out at once.
users.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate {name}? They are signed out at once and cannot sign in until a role is granted again.
users.ownLastAdmin: You cannot remove your own last admin role.
users.conflict: Someone changed this user in the meantime. Nothing was saved; the page shows the current state.
users.invalid: Check the email, the name (2 to 80 characters) and the role.

errors.forbiddenBody: Your roles do not include this page.
errors.notFoundBody: There is nothing at this address.
errors.unauthorizedBody: Sign in to admin to continue.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.lead: Every admin change and every view of personal data. Nothing here can be edited, by anyone.
audit.newest: The newest {count} entries. Narrow the filters to see older ones.

flags.title: Flags
flags.lead: Only the flags in the registry. A change reaches the site within 60 seconds.

checkout.open: Lets the product page's demo button lead to the checkout, per country.
checkout.demo_guard: Keeps every checkout in demo mode: nothing is charged.

flags.orphanLine: Not in the registry. It cannot be changed here.
flags.notSeeded: Not in the database yet. It cannot be changed here.

demo_guard.off: Checkouts will stop being demonstrations wherever checkout is open. Type the flag's name to confirm.
demo_guard.on: Every checkout will be a demonstration again: nothing is charged. Type the flag's name to confirm.

saved.unchanged: Nothing changed: {flag} already had that value.

refused.invalid: That change could not be read. Nothing changed.
refused.unregistered: That flag is not in the registry. Nothing changed.
refused.forbidden: Only an admin can change a high-risk flag. Nothing changed.
refused.mismatch: The name you typed does not match the flag. Nothing changed.
refused.conflict: This flag changed since the page opened. Nothing changed; the current value is shown.
refused.not_seeded: This flag is not in the database. Nothing changed.
